explication: This small Node.js MCP proxy exposes JetBrains IDE tools to clients over stdio. It discovers and periodically refreshes the IDE endpoint, lists available tools, and forwards tool calls and results. The implementation is concentrated in `src/index.ts`; the README also documents configurable host/port selection and optional logging. The graph reflects the sampled source and documented client workflow, not IDE-side implementation details.
